content:
This is an adaptation of callmesam's mellowtron organelle patch (https://patchstorage.com/mellowtron-rework/) which itself is an adaptation of Pierre Massat's PD patch (https://guitarextended.wordpress.com/2014/11/11/yellotron-a-mellotron-with-pure-data/)

I removed the mellowtron patch's reverb because it sounded harsh on my pisound.  I then configured it all to work in ORAC.  It can probably be streamlined a bit more for ORAC so if I make any updates I'll post them here.  

The notes also don't loop indefinitely.  If I can address that I will.
